title: Deleting your account
summary: Remove your own login for good from the app. The store's records stay.

items: In the app, open More › Account › **Delete my account**.
You are signed out on every device and stop getting alerts.
The store's records stay: invoices, checklists and orders you submitted, and team messages and tasks you posted.
The last admin can't delete their account. Make someone else an admin first.
The demo account can't be deleted.
To use RetailOps again, your manager creates a new login.
